key_gap: vs baseline: the pure-style human trace is near-gold — doors counted first, priced as p x impact, meta-door named, deferral premium and cost-of-optionality stated — and the routed m089 pass matched every move first-class (the v5 AI's gaps: door inventory after the cost model, meta-door late, mechanical insights). Residual gap: the door values rest on documented-but-estimated probabilities (no measured frequency data), and the 12-month-or-first-trigger checkpoint is a judgment, not calibrated.
learning_signal: Optionality is a first-class analytical move on decide/guarantee signatures with priced future scenarios: count the doors FIRST (before any cost arithmetic), price every door as p x exposure, count the meta-door (deferring the decision itself), state the cost of optionality, and bind the optionality with an exercise checkpoint — a door without an exercise plan is hoarding, which is exactly the board-history risk the case punishes.
suggested_improvement: Keep single-route m089 on decide/guarantee signatures with deadline/high_stakes context, paired with the R3 m003+m007 gates; add 'meta-door count' and 'cost of optionality stated' to the m089 completion contract (the two signature human moves the v5 AI missed); make the exercise checkpoint a contract output, not a suggestion.
